```{r ui}
library(shinycssloaders)
ui <- fluidPage(
  setBackgroundColor("black"),
  tags$h1("California Mast Prediction Tool", style = "color: white; font-family: 'MS'"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      actionButton("runClimate", "Get Forecasts", class = "btn-primary"),
      sliderInput("year", "Select Year:", min = 1990, max = 2020, value = 2010, sep = "", step = 1,
                  animate = animationOptions(interval = 1500, loop = FALSE)),
      checkboxInput("compareYears", "Compare All Years", value = FALSE),
      checkboxGroupInput("species_selected", "Select Species for Map:", choices = character(0)),
      actionButton("selectAll", "Select All Species"),
      actionButton("uncheckAll", "Uncheck All Species")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      withSpinner(leafletOutput("map", height = 600), type = 6),
      textOutput("statusText")
    )
  )
)
```

``` {r functions}
# testing out a new prism option
get_prism_data <- function(month,
                           year,
                           variable = c("ppt","tmin","tmax","tmean","tdmean","vpdmin","vpdmax"),
                           resolution = c("4km","800m","400m"),
                           region = "us",
                           dataset = c("AN", "LT"),
                           keep_zip = FALSE,
                           overwrite = FALSE) {

  if (!requireNamespace("httr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'httr' is required. Install it with install.packages('httr').", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'terra' is required. Install it with install.packages('terra').", call. = FALSE)
  }

  dataset    <- match.arg(dataset)
  resolution <- match.arg(resolution)
  variable   <- match.arg(variable)

  month <- as.integer(month)
  year  <- as.integer(year)
  if (is.na(month) || month < 1L || month > 12L) stop("'month' must be 1..12.", call. = FALSE)
  if (is.na(year)  || year  < 1895L) stop("'year' must be >= 1895.", call. = FALSE)

  yyyymm <- sprintf("%04d%02d", year, month)

  # Temp directory that will be removed at function exit
  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s",
                                          variable, region, resolution, dataset, yyyymm))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  on.exit({
    if (dir.exists(out_dir)) unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  url <- sprintf("https://services.nacse.org/prism/data/get/%s/%s/%s/%s",
                 region, resolution, variable, yyyymm)
  if (dataset == "LT") url <- paste0(url, "/lt")

  zip_path <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s.zip",
                                         variable, region, resolution, yyyymm))
  if (file.exists(zip_path) && overwrite) unlink(zip_path)

  resp <- httr::GET(
    url,
    httr::write_disk(zip_path, overwrite = TRUE),
    httr::user_agent("R (get_prism_data)")
  )

  # Fail fast on HTTP errors
  httr::stop_for_status(resp)

  # ---- validate we actually got a ZIP ----
  if (!file.exists(zip_path) || is.na(file.info(zip_path)$size) || file.info(zip_path)$size < 100L) {
    stop("Download did not create a valid file on disk.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  sig <- readBin(zip_path, what = "raw", n = 2)
  is_zip <- length(sig) == 2 && identical(sig, charToRaw("PK"))
  if (!is_zip) {
    # Try to show the beginning of the server response for debugging
    txt <- tryCatch(readLines(zip_path, warn = FALSE, n = 20), error = function(e) character())
    snippet <- paste(txt, collapse = "\n")
    if (nchar(snippet) > 800) snippet <- substr(snippet, 1, 800)
    stop(
      paste0(
        "PRISM did not return a ZIP for this request.\n",
        "URL: ", url, "\n\n",
        "First part of response:\n", snippet
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Now it's safe to inspect the zip
  files_in_zip <- utils::unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name
  tif_candidates <- files_in_zip[grepl("\\.tif$", files_in_zip, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(tif_candidates) == 0L) {
    stop("Downloaded ZIP did not contain a .tif file.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  utils::unzip(zip_path, exdir = out_dir, overwrite = overwrite)

  tif_path <- file.path(out_dir, tif_candidates[1])
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) {
    tif_found <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(tif_found) > 0L) tif_path <- tif_found[1]
  }
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) stop("Unzip succeeded but could not locate extracted .tif.", call. = FALSE)

  if (!keep_zip && file.exists(zip_path)) unlink(zip_path)

  # ---- load into memory so temp files can be deleted safely ----
  r_file <- terra::rast(tif_path)

  # Force read values and rebuild an in-memory raster (no on-disk dependency)
  vals <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)  # works for 1+ layers
  r_mem <- terra::rast(r_file)
  terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
  names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)

  r_mem
}

get_prism_normals_data <- function(mon = NULL,
                                   annual = FALSE,
                                   variable = c("ppt","tmin","tmax","tmean","tdmean","vpdmin","vpdmax"),
                                   resolution = c("4km","800m"),
                                   region = c("us","ak"),
                                   normals_end_year = 2020,
                                   keep_zip = FALSE,
                                   overwrite = FALSE) {

  if (!requireNamespace("httr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'httr' is required. Install it with install.packages('httr').", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'terra' is required. Install it with install.packages('terra').", call. = FALSE)
  }

  variable   <- match.arg(variable)
  resolution <- match.arg(resolution)
  region     <- match.arg(region)

  # Normals file naming uses PRISM resolution codes (e.g., 25m for 4km, 30s for 800m).  [oai_citation:2‡PRISM Group](https://prism.oregonstate.edu/formats)
  res_code <- switch(resolution,
                     "4km"  = "25m",
                     "800m" = "30s")

  # Decide temporal subfolder + filename suffix
  if (isTRUE(annual)) {
    temporal <- "monthly"   # annual normals live alongside monthly in PRISM normals dirs (see example listing).  [oai_citation:3‡Oregon State Data Portal](https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/)
    date_tag <- sprintf("%04d", as.integer(normals_end_year))
  } else {
    if (is.null(mon)) stop("Provide mon=1..12 for monthly normals, or set annual=TRUE.", call. = FALSE)
    mon <- as.integer(mon)
    if (is.na(mon) || mon < 1L || mon > 12L) stop("'mon' must be an integer 1..12.", call. = FALSE)
    temporal <- "monthly"
    date_tag <- sprintf("%04d%02d", as.integer(normals_end_year), mon)
  }

  zip_name <- sprintf("prism_%s_%s_%s_%s_avg_30y.zip", variable, region, res_code, date_tag)

  # Build URL like:
  # https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/prism_ppt_us_25m_202002_avg_30y.zip  [oai_citation:4‡Oregon State Data Portal](https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/4km/ppt/monthly/)
  url <- sprintf("https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/%s/%s/%s/%s/%s",
                 region, resolution, variable, temporal, zip_name)

  # Unique temp folder per call (Shiny-safe)
  out_dir <- tempfile("prism_normals_")
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  on.exit({
    if (dir.exists(out_dir)) unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  zip_path <- file.path(out_dir, zip_name)
  if (file.exists(zip_path) && overwrite) unlink(zip_path)

  resp <- httr::GET(
    url,
    httr::write_disk(zip_path, overwrite = TRUE),
    httr::user_agent("R (get_prism_normals_data)")
  )
  httr::stop_for_status(resp)

  # Validate ZIP signature (avoid HTML/redirects saved as .zip)
  sig <- readBin(zip_path, what = "raw", n = 2)
  if (!(length(sig) == 2 && identical(sig, charToRaw("PK")))) {
    txt <- tryCatch(readLines(zip_path, warn = FALSE, n = 20), error = function(e) character())
    snippet <- paste(txt, collapse = "\n")
    if (nchar(snippet) > 800) snippet <- substr(snippet, 1, 800)
    stop(paste0("PRISM normals download did not return a ZIP.\nURL: ", url, "\n\nResponse head:\n", snippet),
         call. = FALSE)
  }

  # Find and unzip the GeoTIFF inside
  files_in_zip <- utils::unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name
  tif_candidates <- files_in_zip[grepl("\\.tif$", files_in_zip, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(tif_candidates) == 0L) stop("Downloaded ZIP did not contain a .tif file.", call. = FALSE)

  utils::unzip(zip_path, exdir = out_dir, overwrite = overwrite)
  tif_path <- file.path(out_dir, tif_candidates[1])

  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) {
    tif_found <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(tif_found) > 0L) tif_path <- tif_found[1]
  }
  if (!file.exists(tif_path)) stop("Unzip succeeded but could not locate extracted .tif.", call. = FALSE)

  if (!keep_zip && file.exists(zip_path)) unlink(zip_path)

  # Load + force into memory so temp files can be deleted safely
  r_file <- terra::rast(tif_path)
  vals   <- terra::values(r_file, mat = TRUE)
  r_mem  <- terra::rast(r_file)
  terra::values(r_mem) <- vals
  names(r_mem) <- names(r_file)

  r_mem
}

getClimate <- function(species, year) {
  # function takes a parameter table x that lists taxa, reproductive phase + climate variable (temp or ppt)
  # also includes months for the climate variable and year - i variable
  
  trees <- filter(treeNames, Species %in% Species) # filter for just species of interest
  
  tree_sf <- st_as_sf(trees, coords = c("UTMx", "UTMy")) # turn data frame into a spatial object
  
  tcrs <- "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84"
  st_crs(tree_sf) <- tcrs
  tree_vec <- vect(tree_sf) # convert tree file to spatial vector
  
  library(prism)
  path <- tempdir() # creates temp directory to store data during the session
  prism_set_dl_dir(path)
  
  # load parameter table here and filter by specified species
  # let's make a table to live inside the function; easier to do this way
  #####
  pine_params <- data.frame(Taxa = c(replicate(9, "Pinus ponderosa"),
                                  replicate(9, "Pinus jeffreyi"),
                                  replicate(9, "Pinus contorta"),
                                  replicate(9, "Pinus lambertiana"),
                                  replicate(9, "Pinus monticola")),
                          Phase = c("temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_Poll", 
                                    "temp_Fert",
                                    "ppt_budInit",
                                    "ppt_budInit",
                                    "ppt_Poll",
                                    "ppt_Poll",
                                    "ppt_Fert",
                                    "ppt_Fert"),
                          Time = c(-2, -1, 0,
                                   -3, -2, 
                                   -2, -1,
                                   -1, 0))

  pine_params$Month <- list(as.numeric(7:11), 
                          as.numeric(3:9), 
                          as.numeric(4:11),
                          as.numeric(10:12), 
                          as.numeric(1:4), 
                          as.numeric(10:12), 
                          as.numeric(1:4), 
                          as.numeric(10:12), 
                          as.numeric(1:4))

  agrifolia_params <- data.frame(Taxa = c(replicate(10, "Quercus agrifolia")),
                                  
                          Phase = c("temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_Poll", 
                                    "temp_Fert",
                                    "ppt_budInit", "ppt_budInit",
                                    "ppt_Poll", "ppt_Poll",
                                    "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Fert"),
                          
                          Time = c(c(-1, 0, 0, 0,
                                   -2, -1, -1, 0, -1, 0)))

  agrifolia_params$Month <- list(as.numeric(6:10), 
                               as.numeric(3:5),
                               as.numeric(4:6), 
                               as.numeric(5:7),
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4))



  oak_params <- data.frame(Taxa = c(replicate(10, "Quercus kelloggii"),
                                  replicate(10, "Quercus chrysolepis")),
                         
                         Phase = c("temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_Poll", 
                                    "temp_Fert",
                                    "ppt_budInit", "ppt_budInit",
                                    "ppt_Poll", "ppt_Poll",
                                    "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Fert"),
                         
                         Time =  c(-2, -1, -1, -1,
                                                -3, -2, -2, -1, -1, 0))

  oak_params$Month <- list(as.numeric(6:10), 
                               as.numeric(3:5),
                               as.numeric(4:6), 
                               as.numeric(5:7),
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4))

  fir_params <- data.frame(Taxa = c(replicate(10, "Abies magnifica"),
                                  replicate(10, "Abies grandis"),
                                  replicate(10, "Abies concolor")),
                         
                         Phase = c("temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_budInit", 
                                    "temp_Poll", 
                                    "temp_Fert",
                                    "ppt_budInit", "ppt_budInit",
                                    "ppt_Poll", "ppt_Poll",
                                    "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Fert"),
                         
                         Time =  c(-1, 0, 0, 0,
                                   -2, -1, -1, 0, 0, 0))

  fir_params$Month <- list(as.numeric(4:11), 
                               as.numeric(4),
                               as.numeric(3:6), 
                               as.numeric(5:9),
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4), 
                               as.numeric(10:12), 
                               as.numeric(1:4))

  all_params <- rbind(pine_params, agrifolia_params, oak_params, fir_params)
  
##### 
  # now process the data in a big loop
  results <- data.frame(NULL)
  params <- filter(all_params, Taxa %in% Species)
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(params)) {
    p <- params[i, ]
    
    phase <- p$Phase # let's isolate the specific phase we are running this for
    mon <- as.numeric(unlist(p$Month)) # isolate the months of climate data
  
    var <- ifelse(grepl("temp", phase) == TRUE, "tmean", "ppt") # selector depending on phase
    time <- p$Time + year # set the year to get data as year for fecundity prediction + time in past
    temp <- data.frame(NULL)

    v <- list()
    
    for(i in mon) {
    v[[i]] <- get_prism_data(month = i, year = year, variable = var, resolution = "4km")
    }
    
    v <- v[vapply(v, function(x) inherits(x, "SpatRaster") && terra::nlyr(x) > 0, logical(1))]
  
  EXT <- lapply(v, terra::extract, y = tree_vec, xy = TRUE, bind = TRUE) # extract climate data for each FIA tree

  #names(EXT) <- paste(mon, time, sep = "_")

  EXT_df <- lapply(EXT, as.data.frame) %>%
    lapply(. ,dplyr::rename, Value = 4) %>%
    do.call(rbind, .) %>%
    mutate(Variable = var) %>%
    group_by() %>%
    mutate(Year = year, Phase = phase) %>%
    drop_na()


  out <<- EXT_df %>%
    group_by(Species, TREE_ID) %>%
    mutate(Value = ifelse(var == "tmean", mean(Value), sum(Value)), Phase = phase) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Value, Phase) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # NEED TO ADD IN HERE THE CLIMATE NORMALS TOO
  
  results <- rbind(results, out)
  }
  
  output <<- results %>%
    group_by(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Phase) %>%
    mutate(Value = ifelse(Phase %in% c("ppt_budInit", "ppt_Fert", "ppt_Poll"), sum(Value), mean(Value))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct()
  
}

  }

  output_norm <<- results %>%

    ungroup() %>%
    distinct() %>%
    rename(normValue = Value) 
  
}

# calculate fecundity
getFecundity <- function(Species) {
  
  coefs <- data.frame(NULL)
  
  for(i in Species) {

  if(grepl("Pinus", i) == TRUE)  {
    cpath <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Pinus_model1_f5_betas.csv' # need to change these to the github link
  } else if(grepl("Quercus", i) == TRUE) {
    cpath <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Quercus_model1_f4_betas.csv'
  } else if(grepl("Abies", i) == TRUE) {
    cpath <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/Abies_model2_f2_betas.csv'
  }
  
  c <- read.csv(cpath) %>%
  mutate(X = gsub("species", "", X)) %>%
  separate(X, c('Species', 'var1', 'var2'), sep = ":") %>%
  mutate(var1 = ifelse(is.na(var1) == TRUE, "Intercept", var1), var2 = ifelse(is.na(var2) == TRUE, "none", var2)) %>%
    filter(var1 != "shade", var2 != "shade") %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species == "quercusChrysole", 
                          "Quercus chrysolepis",
                          ifelse(Species == "quercusKelloggi", 
                                 "Quercus kelloggii", 
                                 ifelse(Species == "quercusAgrifoli", 
                                        "Quercus agrifolia",
                                        ifelse(Species == "pinusContorta", 
                                               "Pinus contorta", 
                                               ifelse(Species == "pinusJeffreyi", 
                                                      "Pinus jeffreyi", 
                                                      ifelse(Species == "pinusLamberti", 
                                                             "Pinus lambertiana", 
                                                             ifelse(Species == "pinusMonticol", 
                                                                    "Pinus monticola",
                                                                    ifelse(Species == "pinusPonderos", 
                                                                           "Pinus ponderosa", 
                                                                           ifelse(Species == "abiesConcolor", 
                                                                                  "Abies concolor", 
                                                                                  ifelse(Species == "abiesMagnific", 
                                                                                         "Abies magnifica",
                                                                                         ifelse(Species == "abiesGrandis", 
                                                                                                "Abies grandis",
                                                                                                NA)))))))))))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
  mutate(beta_obs = estimate, interaction = ifelse(var2 != "none", paste(var1, var2, sep = ":"), var1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, interaction, beta_obs) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = interaction, values_from = beta_obs)
  }
  
  coefs <<- rbind(coefs, c) %>%
    distinct()
  
}


getSeeds <- function(data) {
  Spec <- unique(data$Species)
  
  coefs <- getFecundity(Spec)
  
  output <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, TREE_ID)
  
  results <- data.frame(NULL)
  
  for(i in Spec) {
    
    output2 <- filter(output, Species == i)
    beta_new <- filter(coefs, Species == i)
    data_new <- filter(data, Species == i)
    
  
  if(i %in% c("Pinus ponderosa", "Pinus jeffreyi", "Pinus contorta", "Pinus lambertiana", "Pinus monticola")) {

    output2$Seeds <- beta_new$Intercept +
      beta_new$diam * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$`I(diam^2)` * data_new$diam +
      beta_new$precip_budInit * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(precip_budInit^2)` * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$temp_budInit * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$tmean_Poll * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$tmean_Fert * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$ppt_Poll * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$ppt_Fert * data_new$ppt_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:precip_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:temp_budInit` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_budInit +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$temp_Fert +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Poll +
      beta_new$`diam:ppt_Fert` * data_new$diam * data_new$ppt_Fert
  
} else if(i %in% c("Quercus agrifolia", "Quercus kelloggii", "Quercus chrysolepis")) {
  
    output2$Seeds <<- beta$Intercept +
      beta$diam * data$diam +
      beta$`I(diam^2)` * data$diam +
      beta$precip_budInit * data$ppt_budInit +
      beta$`diam:precip_budInit` * data$diam * data$ppt_budInit +
      beta$temp_budInit * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$`diam:temp_budInit` * data$diam * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$ppt_Poll * data$ppt_Poll +
      beta$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data$diam * data$ppt_Poll +
      beta$tmean_Poll * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$`I(tmean_Poll^2)` * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data$diam * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$ppt_Fert * data$ppt_Fert +
      beta$`diam:ppt_Fert` * data$diam * data$ppt_Fert +
      beta$tmean_Fert * data$temp_Fert +
      beta$`I(tmean_Fert^2)` * data$temp_Fert +
      beta$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data$diam * data$temp_Fert
    
} else if(i %in% c("Abies grandis", "Abies magnifica", "Abies concolor")) {
  
    output2$Seeds <<- beta$Intercept +
      beta$diam * data$diam +
      beta$`I(diam^2)` * data$diam +
      beta$precip_budInit * data$ppt_budInit +
      beta$`I(precip_budInit^2)` * data$ppt_budInit +
      beta$`diam:precip_budInit` * data$diam * data$ppt_budInit +
      beta$temp_budInit * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$`I(temp_budInit^2)` * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$`diam:temp_budInit` * data$diam * data$temp_budInit +
      beta$ppt_Poll * data$ppt_Poll +
      beta$`I(ppt_Poll^2)` * data$ppt_Poll +
      beta$`diam:ppt_Poll` * data$diam * data$ppt_Poll +
      beta$tmean_Poll * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$`I(tmean_Poll^2)` * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$`diam:tmean_Poll` * data$diam * data$temp_Poll +
      beta$tmean_Fert * data$temp_Fert +
      beta$`I(tmean_Fert^2)` * data$temp_Fert +
      beta$`diam:tmean_Fert` * data$diam * data$temp_Fert
    
}
    
    results <<- rbind(results, output2)
  }
}
```

```{r server}
library(shiny)
library(cachem)
library(memoise)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(leaflet)

PRISM_CACHE_DIR <- tools::R_user_dir("fecundity_prism", which = "cache")
dir.create(PRISM_CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
PRISM_CACHE <- cachem::cache_disk(dir = PRISM_CACHE_DIR)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  getClimate_cached <- memoise::memoise(getClimate, cache = PRISM_CACHE)
  getNorm_cached    <- memoise::memoise(getNorm,    cache = PRISM_CACHE)

  # ---- build treeNames (FIA) once per session ----
  treeNames <- reactive({
    plot.list <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/FIA/CA_PLOT.csv") %>%
      dplyr::rename(Plot = 4, Unit = 2, County = 3, STATE = 1, UTMy = 5, UTMx = 6) %>%
      tidyr::unite(Plot, Plot, Unit, County, STATE, sep = "_") %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    tree.list <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/FIA/CA_TREE.csv") %>%
      dplyr::rename(Year = INVYR, Plot = PLOT, Unit = UNITCD, County = COUNTYCD, STATE = STATECD,
                    Subplot = SUBP, Tree = TREE, Diameter = DIA, SPCD = SPCD,
                    SHADE = CLIGHTCD, canopy = CCLCD) %>%
      tidyr::unite(Plot, Plot, Unit, County, STATE, sep = "_") %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    PLOT_TREE <- dplyr::left_join(plot.list, tree.list)

    sp_names <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emoran5/FecundityShinyApp/refs/heads/main/FIA/SPC_ID.csv") %>%
      dplyr::select(SPCD, SCI_NAME)

    merge(PLOT_TREE, sp_names) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Species = SCI_NAME) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Species, Plot, Subplot, Tree) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Year == max(Year)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Species, Plot, Subplot, Tree, UTMx, UTMy, Diameter) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      tidyr::unite("TREE_ID", c(Plot, Subplot, Tree), sep = "_")
  })

  # ---- species choices (from FIA treeNames, not hard-coded) ----
  observeEvent(treeNames(), {
    sp <- sort(unique(treeNames()$Species))
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", choices = sp, selected = sp)
  }, ignoreInit = FALSE)

  observeEvent(input$selectAll, {
    req(treeNames())
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", selected = sort(unique(treeNames()$Species)))
  })

  observeEvent(input$uncheckAll, {
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "species_selected", selected = character(0))
  })

  # ---- base map ----
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, boxZoom = TRUE)) %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
      setView(lng = -119.418, lat = 36.778, zoom = 5)
  })

  # ---- PRISM + getSeeds on click ----
  seed_points <- eventReactive(input$runClimate, {
    req(input$year, input$species_selected, treeNames())

    # Make treeNames available in this scope for functions that expect it
    treeNames <- treeNames()

    yr <- as.integer(input$year)
    sp <- sort(input$species_selected)
    validate(need(length(sp) > 0, "Select at least one species."))

    output$statusText <- renderText("Running PRISM downloads + computing forecasts...")

    clim_out <- getClimate_cached(sp, yr)
    norm_out <- getNorm_cached(sp, yr)

    anom <- merge(clim_out, norm_out) %>%
      mutate(Value = Value - normValue) %>%
      select(Species, TREE_ID, Year, Phase, Value) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Phase, values_from = Value) %>%
      drop_na()

    seeds <- getSeeds(anom)

    list(seeds = seeds, year = yr)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  observeEvent(seed_points(), {
    res <- seed_points()
    seeds <- res$seeds
    yr <- res$year

    validate(need(!is.null(seeds) && nrow(seeds) > 0, "No results returned for this selection."))

    value_col <- dplyr::case_when(
      "logF_current" %in% names(seeds) ~ "logF_current",
      "fecundity"    %in% names(seeds) ~ "fecundity",
      "Value"        %in% names(seeds) ~ "Value",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
    validate(need(!is.na(value_col), "No value column found (expected logF_current/fecundity/Value)."))
    validate(need(all(c("X","Y") %in% names(seeds)), "Expected X and Y columns for mapping."))

    pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(c("red", "blue"), seeds[[value_col]])

    leafletProxy("map", data = seeds) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      clearControls() %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = ~X, lat = ~Y, radius = 3,
        color = ~pal(.data[[value_col]]),
        opacity = 0.8,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>Species:</b> ", Species, "<br>",
          "<b>Tree:</b> ", TREE_ID, "<br>",
          "<b>Year:</b> ", yr, "<br>",
          "<b>Predicted:</b> ", round(.data[[value_col]], 3)
        )
      ) %>%
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = seeds[[value_col]],
                title = "Predicted", opacity = 1)

    output$statusText <- renderText(
      paste("Last run:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            "Year:", yr, "Points:", nrow(seeds))
    )
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  output$statusText <- renderText({
    "Select a year and species, then click 'Get Forecasts'."
  })
}
```

```{r app}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
